annotations.title: Minimum wage increase payroll impact calculator

description: Estimate the added annual payroll and employer taxes when the minimum wage rises, including raises for workers just above the new minimum. Use this tested BusCalc worksheet when the task matches its inputs and scope. Returns named results, units, formula, assumptions, method version, reference-value notes (official figure or your figure, with source and effective date), a check link and a source-page URL. Official reference values are prefilled when omitted; supply every other figure from the user's records. Percent fields take percent numbers. No figures are looked up; no private projects or purchases are accessed. Put tool fields inside inputs. Put tool fields inside inputs. Supply units or modelVersion only when listed in inputSchema. Follow its required fields and exact choices. Do not pass the REST calculator field inside MCP arguments.

bands.description: Wage bands. Use matching records or an explicitly identified assumption for wage bands. Unknown is not the same as zero.

hours.description: Annual hours per worker (hours). Use matching records or an explicitly identified assumption for annual hours per worker. Unknown is not the same as zero.

rate.description: Current hourly rate (currency/hour). Use matching records or an explicitly identified assumption for current hourly rate. Unknown is not the same as zero.

workers.description: Workers in band (people). Use matching records or an explicitly identified assumption for workers in band. Unknown is not the same as zero.

compression.description: Compression raise for workers just above the new minimum. Percent number: 6.2 means 6.2%. Use matching records or an explicitly identified assumption for compression raise for workers just above the new minimum. Unknown is not the same as zero.

newMin.description: New minimum wage (your figure) (currency/hour). Use matching records or an explicitly identified assumption for new minimum wage (your figure). Unknown is not the same as zero.

range.description: Compression range above the new minimum (currency/hour). Use matching records or an explicitly identified assumption for compression range above the new minimum. Unknown is not the same as zero.

tax.description: Employer payroll tax rate on added wages (your figure). Percent number: 6.2 means 6.2%. For example FICA 7.65% plus any state taxes that apply to these wages. Wage-base caps are ignored.

modelVersion.description: Optional expected method version; a mismatch is rejected.

name: buscalc_minimum_wage_increase_payroll_impact_calculator

checkURL.description: Link that replays this calculation on https://buscalc.com/sumtru/verify/. Null when the inputs hold free-form text or the link would be too long.

notes.description: Reference-value notes first, then model notes and the standard limit statement.

referenceValues.description: One entry per official reference value in play: the official figure, the figure used, status official or user, source, effective date and the note text.

sealURL.description: Where a saved record of this result can be sealed with an independent timestamp.
